scenarios.name: a child can edit their own post but not a sibling's, and cannot moderate even their own; an adult can hide a post

steps.sql: INSERT INTO app_memory_wall__walls (id, title, status, post_visibility, created_by, created_at) VALUES ('w1', 'Farewell Sam', 'open', 'everyone', ?, '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z')

INSERT INTO app_memory_wall__posts (id, wall_id, member_id, body, source, status, visibility, created_at) VALUES ('pa', 'w1', ?, 'We will miss you', 'member', 'published', 'everyone', '2026-01-02T00:00:00Z'), ('pb', 'w1', ?, 'Good luck Sam', 'member', 'published', 'everyone', '2026-01-02T00:00:01Z')
UPDATE app_memory_wall__posts SET body = 'defaced' WHERE id = 'pa'
